accounts.name: mint
docs: Fresh keypair. The coin PDA is mint authority only for the length of
this instruction; no freeze authority is ever set.

accounts.name: creator_token_account
docs: Created only if the creator buys at launch; its address is enforced.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Writable only for burning tokens someone planted in the graduation
account (burning lowers the mint's supply).

accounts.name: graduation_authority
docs: Signs for riff as the Raydium pool creator. Holds SOL only during
this instruction.

accounts.name: graduation_token_account
docs: emptied and closed here. Address enforced.

accounts.name: graduation_wsol_account
docs: and closed here. Address enforced.

accounts.name: graduation_lp_account
docs: its LP tokens are burned and it's closed here. Address enforced.

accounts.name: pool_state
docs: creation. Raydium creates and owns the account.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Must be the program's upgrade authority, so nobody can front-run
deployment and claim the config.

fields.name: late
docs: Claimed after the claim window closed.

fields.name: forfeited_to_charity
docs: Fees held for the artist that went to the charity instead because
the claim was late.

types.name: Coin
docs: One launched coin. PDA at `[COIN_SEED, mint]`.
The artist is recorded only as text until they claim the coin; until then
`artist` is `None` and nothing implies the artist is affiliated with it.
Holds the curve's SOL and all uncollected fees as lamports, on top of its
own rent.

fields.name: vault
docs: Program-owned token account holding the full supply.

fields.name: artist
docs: Set when the artist claims the coin.

fields.name: created_slot
docs: Slot the coin was created in. `buy` is closed for this slot, so the
creator's capped launch buy is the only purchase possible at launch.

fields.name: claim_deadline
docs: Last moment the artist may claim, fixed at creation from the config's
claim window so later config changes don't move it.

fields.name: artist_fees
docs: Artist fees held for the artist, in lamports: accrued before the claim
window closed, or after the artist claimed.

fields.name: charity_fees
docs: Artist-share fees owed to the charity and not yet swept, in lamports.

fields.name: creator_fees
docs: Creator fees accrued and not yet withdrawn, in lamports.

fields.name: protocol_fees
docs: Protocol fees accrued and not yet collected to the treasury, in lamports.

fields.name: complete
docs: Every curve token has been sold; trading stops until graduation.

fields.name: pool
docs: Raydium pool the coin graduated to. Set once, by `graduate`.

fields.name: graduation_sol
docs: Curve SOL handed to the graduation authority by `prepare_graduation`
and not yet deposited in the pool (0 before and after graduation).

fields.name: artist_fees_total
docs: Every artist share of every curve trade fee, in lamports, whether it
went to the artist or to charity. Never decreases.

fields.name: peak_virtual_sol
docs: Highest virtual SOL reserves the curve has reached. The price only
rises with virtual SOL, so this marks the curve's all-time-high price.

fields.name: volume_hourly
docs: Curve trade volume (SOL into or out of the curve, before fees) per
hour for the last 24 hours: `volume_hourly[h % 24]` holds unix hour
`h`, for `h` in `volume_hour - 23 ..= volume_hour`.

fields.name: volume_hour
docs: Unix hour (seconds / 3600) of the latest trade.

fields.name: creator_buy_tokens
docs: Tokens the creator bought at launch (0 if none).

fields.name: creator_buy_sol
docs: SOL the creator paid for them, fees included.

types.name: Config
docs: Protocol-wide settings. Singleton PDA at `[CONFIG_SEED]`.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Proposed next admin; becomes admin only by signing `accept_admin`.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Receives the protocol's share of trading fees, in batches, via the
permissionless `collect_protocol_fees`. Trades never touch it, so it
needn't sign or exist in advance (e.g. a Squads vault).

fields.name: charity
docs: Receives artist fees nobody can claim: the artist's share for a coin
whose claim window closed unclaimed. riff donates from it.

fields.name: verifier
docs: Co-signs every `claim_artist`, vouching that the claiming wallet
belongs to the coin's artist. Held by riff's verification service.

fields.name: raydium_amm_config
docs: Raydium CPMM fee tier (`AmmConfig` account) graduated coins' pools use.

fields.name: artist_fee_bps
docs: Trading fee rates, each in basis points of a trade's SOL amount. Their
sum is the total fee charged.

fields.name: claim_window_secs
docs: How long after a coin's creation its artist may claim it, in seconds.

fields.name: initial_virtual_sol_reserves
docs: Starting virtual reserves for every new coin's curve.

fields.name: initial_virtual_token_reserves
docs: Derived from the supply split so the graduation pool opens at the
curve's final price; see `curve::graduation_virtual_token_reserves`.

fields.name: curve_token_supply
docs: Tokens sellable on the curve; the rest of the supply stays in the
vault as the graduation reserve.

fields.name: max_creator_buy_bps
docs: Most the creator may buy at launch, in basis points of total supply.

fields.name: artist_fee_bps
docs: Fee rates in basis points of each trade's SOL amount.

fields.name: curve_token_supply
docs: Tokens sold on the curve. The graduation reserve is the rest of the
supply, and the starting virtual token reserves are derived from both.

fields.name: max_creator_buy_bps
docs: Creator launch-buy cap, in basis points of total supply.

fields.name: artist_id
docs: External artist identifier (e.g. a streaming-platform artist ID).

fields.name: creator_buy_sol
docs: Most SOL (fee included) the creator spends buying at launch, from the
same curve as everyone else. 0 for no buy. The tokens bought may not
exceed the config's cap.

fields.name: creator_buy_min_tokens
docs: Fewest tokens the launch buy may return. The curve is fresh, but the
config's fees and curve settings could change between signing and
landing.

fields.name: sol_amount
docs: SOL deposited into the pool: exactly what the curve raised.

fields.name: token_amount
docs: Tokens deposited: exactly the graduation reserve.

fields.name: lp_burned
docs: Every LP token minted to riff, burned so the liquidity is locked.

fields.name: cost_reimbursed
docs: Pool-creation cost reimbursed to the caller from protocol fees.

fields.name: sol_amount
docs: Curve SOL moved to the graduation authority for the pool.

fields.name: sol_amount
docs: SOL into (buy) or out of (sell) the curve's reserves, before fees.

types.name: UpdateConfigParams
docs: Settings to change; `None` leaves one unchanged. Fees and curve settings
can't be changed here, and nothing here can touch funds held by coins.

fields.name: claim_window_secs
docs: Claim window for coins launched from now on. Existing coins keep the
deadline they got at launch.

constants.name: BPS_DENOMINATOR
docs: Basis-point denominator (100%).

constants.name: COIN_TOTAL_SUPPLY
docs: 1,000,000,000 whole tokens, in base units. Minted once at creation; never more.

constants.name: MAX_CREATOR_BUY_BPS
docs: Highest creator launch-buy cap the config will accept (10% of supply).

constants.name: MAX_TRADE_FEE_BPS
docs: Highest total trading fee the config will accept (10%).

constants.name: POOL_SEED
docs: riff PDA used as the graduated coin's Raydium pool address. Only riff can
sign for it, so nobody can create the graduation pool first.
